guardrails.preferred: Report novel-view rendering metrics separately from geometric surface metrics.
A deterministic completion is one conditional estimate, not samples from a calibrated posterior.
Independent stochastic point decoding does not by itself define one coherent sampled scene hypothesis.
forbidden_patterns: independent point stochasticity is scene stochasticity
more sampled points imply a scene posterior
arbitrary-resolution point sampling is coherent scene sampling
pooled point diversity proves scene diversity

guardrails.preferred: Time-conditioned rendering, temporal smoothness, and high image quality do not establish material correspondence or persistent identity through occlusion.
forbidden_patterns: dynamic view synthesis proves persistent tracking
